title: Point-of-order decision support for imaging in low back pain: an umbrella review
abstract: Objective: to synthesise systematic reviews of point-of-order imaging decision support, with a focus on low back pain. Design: umbrella review with AMSTAR 2 appraisal and overlap analysis. Outcomes: inappropriate orders, patient outcomes, override and equity. Results will follow screening and synthesis.
introduction: Many overlapping reviews of imaging decision support exist, with low methodological quality. A region procuring a tool needs an appraised synthesis.
methods: Registered protocol; four databases; two reviewers; AMSTAR 2; citation matrix and corrected covered area; primary review per outcome.
results: No data have been collected yet.
discussion: The discussion will translate the findings into specification requirements and monitoring recommendations.
limitations: Review quality, overlap and language restriction.
summary: Umbrella review report structure with results left empty.
